name: uv cache (Python)
what_it_is: Python packages uv already downloaded. It fetches them again when needed.
how_to_free: With the tool's own command: `uv cache clean`

name: pip cache
what_it_is: Python packages downloaded by pip.
how_to_free: With the tool's own command: `pip cache purge`

name: npm cache
what_it_is: Copies of packages npm already installed. It downloads them again if needed.
how_to_free: With the tool's own command: `npm cache clean --force`

name: npx temporary packages
what_it_is: Tools npx downloaded to run once.
how_to_free: By emptying the folder's contents (the folder stays).

name: pnpm store
what_it_is: Packages shared by your projects. “prune” only removes the ones no project uses.
how_to_free: With the tool's own command: `pnpm store prune`

name: pnpm cache
what_it_is: Package metadata downloaded by pnpm.
how_to_free: By emptying the folder's contents (the folder stays).

name: Yarn cache
what_it_is: Packages downloaded by Yarn.
how_to_free: With the tool's own command: `yarn cache clean`

name: Bun cache
what_it_is: Packages downloaded by Bun.
how_to_free: With the tool's own command: `bun pm cache rm`

name: Homebrew cache
what_it_is: Installers for programs Homebrew already installed.
how_to_free: With the tool's own command: `brew cleanup -s`

name: Gradle cache
what_it_is: Dependencies for Android and Java projects. The next build will take longer.
how_to_free: By emptying the folder's contents (the folder stays).

name: Xcode build data
what_it_is: Intermediate build results. Xcode recreates them.
how_to_free: By emptying the folder's contents (the folder stays).

name: Xcode iOS symbols
what_it_is: Debug data for iOS versions. Recreated when you connect an iPhone.
how_to_free: By emptying the folder's contents (the folder stays).

name: Playwright browsers
what_it_is: Browsers for automated tests. Downloaded again with npx playwright install.
how_to_free: By emptying the folder's contents (the folder stays).

name: Puppeteer browsers
what_it_is: Chrome downloaded by Puppeteer. Downloaded again when used.
how_to_free: By emptying the folder's contents (the folder stays).

name: Prisma engines
what_it_is: Prisma binaries. Downloaded again when you generate the client.
how_to_free: By emptying the folder's contents (the folder stays).

name: Codex runtimes
what_it_is: Codex runtime environments. Downloaded again when you open it.
how_to_free: By emptying the folder's contents (the folder stays).

name: Installers already used
path: ~/Downloads/<installers of installed apps and already extracted archives>
what_it_is: Installers of apps you already have installed and archives you already extracted: what they contained is already on your Mac. If you ever need them, they can be downloaded again.
how_to_free: By deleting it (to the Trash).

name: Old update installers
what_it_is: App updates that were already installed (Kimi, MiniMax, Electron…).
how_to_free: By deleting it (to the Trash).

name: Downloaded Google updates
what_it_is: Packages the Chrome updater already installed.
how_to_free: By emptying the folder's contents (the folder stays).

name: Chrome web cache
what_it_is: Pages and images saved by Chrome. Rebuilt as you browse; best with Chrome closed.
how_to_free: Quit Google Chrome first. By emptying the folder's contents (the folder stays).

name: Claude app cache
what_it_is: Interface cache. Rebuilt automatically; quit the app first.
how_to_free: Quit Claude first. By deleting it (to the Trash).

name: Old Claude Code versions
what_it_is: The Claude app downloads every new Claude Code version but only uses the latest.
how_to_free: By deleting it (to the Trash).

name: Codex temporary files
what_it_is: Temporary files from Codex.
how_to_free: By emptying the folder's contents (the folder stays).

name: claude-mem logs
what_it_is: Logs from the claude-mem memory plugin.
how_to_free: By emptying the folder's contents (the folder stays).

name: Downloaded Gradle versions
what_it_is: Each project downloads the Gradle version it asks for. Downloaded again when you build.
how_to_free: By emptying the folder's contents (the folder stays).

name: Temporary Rust for Python packages
what_it_is: Rust downloaded only to build some Python packages. Downloaded again if needed.
how_to_free: By deleting it (to the Trash).

name: Android Studio cache
what_it_is: Android Studio indexes and caches. Recreated when you open it.
how_to_free: By deleting it (to the Trash).

name: Unfinished Docker install
what_it_is: Leftovers from a Docker Desktop install or update that already finished; quit Docker first.
how_to_free: Quit Docker first. By deleting it (to the Trash).

name: Kimi cache
path: ~/Library/Application Support/kimi-desktop/Cache, Code Cache, GPUCache, DawnGraphiteCache, DawnWebGPUCache
what_it_is: Kimi's interface cache. Rebuilt automatically; quit the app first.
how_to_free: Quit Kimi first. By deleting it (to the Trash).

name: Perplexity cache
what_it_is: Pages and images saved by the Perplexity app. Rebuilt automatically; quit the app first.
how_to_free: Quit Perplexity first. By emptying the folder's contents (the folder stays).

name: generate_appcast cache (Sparkle)
what_it_is: Copies that Sparkle's generate_appcast tool unpacks to sign updates. It creates them again next time.
how_to_free: By deleting it (to the Trash).

name: Apple Python cache
what_it_is: .pyc files that Xcode's and macOS's Python compile to start faster. They're recreated automatically.
how_to_free: By deleting it (to the Trash).

name: App logs
what_it_is: Log files. Only useful for diagnosing past errors.
how_to_free: By emptying the folder's contents (the folder stays).

name: Docker virtual disk
what_it_is: Images, containers and volumes. Volumes can hold databases.
how_to_free: With the tool's own command: `docker system prune -f`

name: OrbStack data
what_it_is: OrbStack machines and containers.
how_to_free: With the tool's own command: `docker system prune -f`

name: Claude virtual machine
what_it_is: Used by the Claude app to run tasks. Downloaded again; quit the app first.
how_to_free: Quit Claude first. By deleting it (to the Trash).

name: iPhone simulators
what_it_is: Each simulator keeps the apps and data from your tests. Xcode creates them again.
how_to_free: Delete them one by one in DiskSpace AI or in Xcode → Devices and Simulators.

name: Xcode archives
what_it_is: Released versions of your apps. Needed to read crash reports.
how_to_free: Delete old ones from Xcode → Organizer.

name: Android SDK
what_it_is: Android platforms and tools.
how_to_free: Remove versions you don't use from Android Studio → SDK Manager.

name: Android emulators
what_it_is: Each emulator keeps its own disk.
how_to_free: Delete the ones you don't use from Android Studio → Device Manager.

name: Global npm packages
what_it_is: Terminal tools installed with npm install -g. See which you have with npm ls -g --depth=0.
how_to_free: With the tool's own command: `npm uninstall -g `

name: Hugging Face models
what_it_is: Downloaded AI models. They can be downloaded again, but they're big.
how_to_free: huggingface-cli delete-cache (lets you choose which models to delete).

name: Ollama models
what_it_is: Local AI models. See which you use with ollama list.
how_to_free: With the tool's own command: `ollama rm `

name: LM Studio models
what_it_is: Local AI models downloaded from LM Studio.
how_to_free: Delete the ones you don't use from LM Studio → My Models.

name: Whisper models
what_it_is: Speech-to-text models. Downloaded again when used.
how_to_free: By emptying the folder's contents (the folder stays).

name: PyTorch models
what_it_is: Model weights downloaded by PyTorch.
how_to_free: By emptying the folder's contents (the folder stays).

name: Chroma models
what_it_is: Embedding models downloaded by Chroma.
how_to_free: By emptying the folder's contents (the folder stays).

name: Chrome AI model
what_it_is: Gemini Nano, which Chrome downloads by itself. It comes back unless you turn it off in chrome://flags.
how_to_free: Quit Google Chrome first. By deleting it (to the Trash).

name: iPhone backups
what_it_is: Local backups of your devices.
how_to_free: Manage from Finder → your iPhone → Manage Backups.

name: Installers in Downloads
what_it_is: Downloaded installers and archives. Usually no longer needed.
how_to_free: By deleting it (to the Trash).

name: Desktop screenshots
path: ~/Desktop/Captura de pantalla *, Screenshot *, Grabación de pantalla *, Screen Recording *, CleanShot *
what_it_is: Screenshots and screen recordings macOS saves on the Desktop. Check whether you need any: the ones you clean are kept 7 days.
how_to_free: By deleting it (to the Trash).

name: Trash
what_it_is: Files you already deleted.
how_to_free: Empty the Trash from the Finder.

name: Claude Code plugins
what_it_is: Plugins installed in Claude Code. If you delete them, you'll have to reinstall them.
how_to_free: Uninstall the ones you don't use with /plugin in Claude Code.

name: claude-mem search index
what_it_is: Index for searching claude-mem's memory; rebuilt from its database.
how_to_free: By deleting it (to the Trash).

name: Aerial wallpapers
what_it_is: Videos for macOS aerial wallpapers and screen savers. The one you pick is downloaded again.
how_to_free: By emptying the folder's contents (the folder stays).

name: uv Python versions
what_it_is: Python versions installed by uv. Your projects' .venv environments depend on them. See which you have with uv python list.
how_to_free: With the tool's own command: `uv python uninstall `

name: MiniMax agents
what_it_is: Data and settings for MiniMax Agent's agents.
how_to_free: Review it in MiniMax Agent.

name: Chrome profiles
what_it_is: History, sessions and extensions.
how_to_free: This is your browsing data.

name: Photos library
what_it_is: Your photos and videos.
how_to_free: Photos → Settings → iCloud → Optimize Mac Storage.

name: Claude Code (version in use)
what_it_is: The Claude Code version the Claude app is using right now.
how_to_free: This is the version in use.

name: Claude Code history
what_it_is: Your Claude Code conversations, by project.
how_to_free: These are your conversations.

name: Codex history
what_it_is: Your Codex sessions.
how_to_free: These are your sessions.

name: claude-mem memory
what_it_is: The database with the memory saved by the claude-mem plugin.
how_to_free: This is your saved memory.

name: Slack cache
what_it_is: Slack's interface cache: pages, images and code it already loaded. It rebuilds itself when you open the app; your messages, sessions and settings aren't here.
how_to_free: Quit Slack first. By deleting it (to the Trash).
